{{Quote|&mdash;the assassinations today of Senator Nehal and her aide&mdash;|A fragmented recording of Albathius|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Nehal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who was [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] along with her [[Nehal's aide|aide]]. After her death, [[Albathius]]&mdash;an operative of the [[Star Cabal]]&mdash;gave a speech in which he spoke of her death.
